pypi.summary: Python bindings for the Qt cross platform application toolkit

earlier.note: One hit in QtNetwork.pyi (type stubs: enum and argument names such as password / token). The native modules are the PyQt bindings. No attestation: content review only.

reviewed.note: macOS universal2 and Windows amd64 wheels of the reviewed version: same members (Windows adds the Windows-only QAxContainer module, .pyd + stubs + .sip). .pyi stubs, PyQt6.api, .sip and .toml binding files differ by platform (module-tags Linux/macOS/Windows, platform-only classes, include order); Windows __init__.py adds Riverbank's find_qt(), which puts PyQt6/Qt6/bin on the DLL search path. The 24 'new' keys are the reviewed QtNetwork.pyi hits. Mach-O modules link only Qt frameworks via @rpath (@loader_path/Qt6/lib), no flagged imports; the .pyd files only CRT ones. No .pth, no hook. No attestation, as for the Linux wheel: content review only.
